description:
Does this broker hold active broker authority, and what does FMCSA's
record say around it? Give exactly one of mc_number (the broker's MC
docket, written MC123456, MC-123456 or 123456) or usdot_number. Paid, flat
price; billed whenever the carrier resolves, including when it holds no
broker authority (that is the answer). An unknown docket or USDOT number
is a free not_found; giving neither or both, or a docket FMCSA lists under
several carriers without naming a holder, is a free error.

Returns holds_active_broker_authority and the broker dockets (docket
number, status, how current that status is, active types, first grant and
last event dates); the bond (BMC-84/85) on-file flag with its continuity
(coverage unbroken since, current gap, closed lapses in 24 and 60 months,
longest gap, data-through date); the authority event history (grants,
reinstatements, revocations, suspensions, in total and over 24 and 60
months); revocation, suspension and reinstatement flags; and the identity
linkage screen. A record, not a recommendation or a rating.

How far to trust "holds active broker authority": it is as complete as the
two FMCSA sources behind it. FMCSA froze its legacy licensing archive on
2026-05-14, so a docket known only from it (status_source legacy_li)
describes that date, and a docket whose status changed afterwards and is
not yet on FMCSA's live MOTUS roster is not seen. There is no independent
count of real brokers to check against. Confirm the broker's current
authority and bond with FMCSA before relying on it.
name: check_broker_authority
